title: First time making a game with 0 experience in game development, Ai , just IDEAS
author: Angry_Banana2

comments.author: zayelion
comments.body:
Its going to be slow going but what you actually want to do is DRAW your finished product in something like gimp or paint. Then get a compiled nothing burger of the start screen or studio name page running. 

After thatt describe each page going left to right top to bottom of each thing you seen and what it does. Then write out all the game mechanics and interactions.

Feed it that document about a paragraph at a time for as long as it takes to process in 1 pass. Then repeat this process. AI-game-development is basically supped up project management.

replies.author: Angry_Banana2
replies.body:
I'm making the Ai do brainstorming for some ideas and concepts
I have mine cause I've played and watched a lot of games 
And many of theme were in this genre
After that i get to decide what to keep and what to let go
Sometimes i let the ai do some research on the possibilities if i got stuck and didn't have a clear criteria to choose from
Then the AI brings me a list of pros and cons of each feature
Even the small details and localization on the screen
Why each detail goes where 
And sets some variables and compares them for the most efficient result
Then i choose the ones i like to keep
Add my ideas and concepts 
And polish it to make a clear idea of how the feature of the game will run and act
Make sure that its documented 
And move onto the next step

I've done it more than once now 
And i have a clear vision of what will the game feel like without the UI/UX .
How the mechanics will work and act when implemented
And i have a vision for the UI/UX and interface and interactions and transitions

So i just have to join and merge things together using an engine and try some designs and effects and etc 

Until i get a fully playable version 
Then i run my tests to make sure its pleasing for the player and doesn't need further polishing
Cause the code debugging and tests will be done with the ai tools such as claude and codex
I have to try the human side of it and make a review of what i tried
Which feature needs to be changed and why
Which to keep and why
Which to get rid of and why
Which to replace with what and why

Until i need to tests and the game it to my likings
